correctness.rationale: The Montesinos double-branched-cover relation matrix [[p,0,0,3],[0,q,0,-8],[0,0,q,-8],[1,1,1,0]] has determinant q(16p-3q) with p=3b+5,q=8b+13. Thus det=(8b+13)(24b+41)>0. Symbolic first difference is 384b+832>0. The factors are coprime (difference of second minus triple first equals 2), while 24b+41=2 mod3 so cannot be square; hence product is nonsquare. Fox–Milnor forbids algebraic sliceness, and topological sliceness implies algebraic. Computation through b=150 only corroborates the symbolic all-b proof. Nakamura local-move construction is an explicitly cited external premise; its recent full text was unavailable in this run, so not independently re-proved. The frozen RESULT source contains literal control characters corrupting alpha/beta/fraction/right KaTeX, independently checked at its Git blob, hence an exact corrected full UTF-8 RESULT.md is supplied.

value.rationale: It gives an all-parameter exact concordance obstruction on a naturally motivated two-site delta-unknotting family and certifies pairwise distinction by one invariant. Although the final modular obstruction is short, it answers a concrete topological question about every member of the family rather than an arbitrary numeric slice; no stronger general theorem is claimed.
residual_risks: Nonsliceness does not specify concordance order and is weaker than full knot-type classification.

final_claim: For b>=-1, Nakamura two-site delta-unknotting family K_b=M(0;(3b+5,-3),(8b+13,8),(8b+13,8)) has det K_b=(8b+13)(24b+41), strictly increasing and nonsquare; consequently all K_b are pairwise nonisotopic and none algebraically or topologically locally flat slice.
